portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant
to your system have been applied.

This update is available via the Red Hat Network. Details on how to use the Red
Hat Network to apply this update are available at
https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
NetworkManager is a system network service that manages network devices and
connections, attempting to keep active network connectivity when available. Its
capabilities include managing Ethernet, wireless, mobile broadband (WWAN), and
PPPoE devices, as well as providing VPN integration with a variety of different
VPN services.

This update fixes the following bugs:

* Due to a race condition, the NetworkManager service could previously terminate
unexpectedly when reading the bridge sysctl values failed. With this update, the
race condition is prevented, which in turn prevents the crash in the described
scenario. (BZ#1112262) 

* Prior to this update, the NetworkManager service did not set the correct
maximum transmission unit (MTU) in some situations. As a consequence, the
network connection speed could be very low, in particular when tunneling
protocols were used. With this update, MTU is set correctly and the network
connection slowdown no longer occurs. (BZ#1114868)

Users of NetworkManager are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which
fix these bugs.
